activity.notes: After royalist victory in Peru, Pedro de La Gasca confirmed Valdivia's title and he resumed the governorship of Chile in 1549. He governed until his capture and death at Tucapel on 25 December 1553. ATLAS separates this restored term from the first governorship instead of fabricating a continuous 1541-1553 office.

sources.title: Pedro de Valdivia — Memoria Chilena, Biblioteca Nacional de Chile
sources.citation_text: Chile's National Library records Valdivia's governorship, its confirmation, and his death at Tucapel on 25 December 1553.

sources.title: Gobernadores chilenos — Memoria Chilena
sources.citation_text: Memoria Chilena lists two Valdivia governorship phases separated by a genuine interval: 1540/1541-1547 and 1549-1553.
